items.docs: Get the activity eligibility_request of a loan.
Retrieve a loan by its ID. Returns the full loan details including status, amounts, repayment schedule, borrower information, and related documents.

Updates a loan.
- When the loan is SUBMITTED or TO_VALIDATE, all the below fields can be updated.
- When the loan is VALIDATED or SCHEDULED, the references and to_repay_at fields can be updated.
- When the loan is TO_REPAY, only the to_repay_at change be changed. The earliest acceptable date being loan.earliest_to_repay_at.

This operation is not available when the loan is in another status.

params.name: borrower
params.description: Search by borrower company number (e.g. SIREN or NIF)

params.name: contractual_repayment_date_from
params.description: Returns loans where contractual_repayment_date field is greater or equal to this date.

params.name: contractual_repayment_date_to
params.description: Returns loans where contractual_repayment_date field is lower to this date.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_page field. Omit to get the first page.

params.name: guarantee_called
params.description: Returns loans for which the guarantee was called

params.name: guarantor
params.description: Entity legally responsible to payback the loan

params.name: id
params.description: Filter by one or more loan UUIDs.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: postponed
params.description: Returns loans that have been postponed

params.name: query
params.description: Search for loans based on one or more of the following fields: loan ID, invoice number, amount, estimated fees, status, or counterparty name.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Specify the sorting field and order. Default sorting: created_at DESC. Possible values: ['created_at:asc', 'created_at:desc', 'to_repay_at:asc', 'to_repay_at:desc', 'to_pay_at:asc', 'to_pay_at:desc']

params.name: to_pay_at_from
params.description: Returns loans where pay_at field is greater or equal to this date.

params.name: to_pay_at_to
params.description: Returns loans where pay_at field is lower to this date.

params.name: to_repay_at_from
params.description: Returns loans where repay_at field is greater or equal to this date.

params.name: to_repay_at_to
params.description: Returns loans where repay_at field is lower to this date.

params.name: to_repay_at_within_days
params.description: Shorthand alias for to_repay_at_from=now() and to_repay_at_to=now().plus(x, 'days'). Mutually exclusive with to_repay_at_from & to_repay_at_to.
